title: Cahn behind Flater's complaint
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Cahn behind Flater's complaint, about 1953 at Denver, Colorado, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: cuz it was Khan that contacted Flater.

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, who studies a story of a crashed craft said to have carried 16 alien bodies, talks about events in Denver, Colorado, in 1953. He says a complaint made by a man named Herman Flater was really driven by a man named J.P. Cahn, because it was Cahn who contacted Flater first, and the story also names J. Edgar Hoover, then head of the FBI, the US federal police. If true, it would mean the complaint was steered from behind the scenes rather than coming from Flater alone.
